data.narrative:
Aeon Industrial is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Naweed Tahmas and Joe Cieslik that has raised $18.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning both private and public markets, with the broader frontier-defense universe including approximately 10 private companies (UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic among them) and 2 public references.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression, using total capital raised as a proxy base ($19M), applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x, yielding $46M. Peer-Median triangulation across the 5-company comparable set (range: $125M–$4.0B) produces a $1.0B median, reflecting the wide dispersion common in early-stage defense tech. The $1.0B result is anchored by UFORCE at $1.0B in the same stage and Stark Defence at $4.0B, offset by NODA AI at $125M.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $40M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $523M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty regarding Aeon's competitive positioning within a heterogeneous peer set marked by 32x valuation spread. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor; peer median implies substantial premium to raised capital. Key sensitivities include product differentiation, customer traction relative to named competitors, and actual burn profile versus typical Seed-stage Defense & Security benchmarks.
